entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: A white-feathered siren navigator and lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: Malcolm's best friend, an irrepressible goblin pirate.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who hired Malcolm as captain of the Belligerent.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who joined the Belligerent while amnesiac and later posed as Ashiok.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker on whose behalf Vraska sought the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Fought over the Immortal Sun; leads an expedition.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: Vampire who fought over the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: Asks Malcolm and Breeches to investigate disappearances in Downtown.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Assembles outlaws for the Thunder Junction vault raid.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young creature Jace sought from the vault.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Provides backup helping the team escape.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: Entity controlling the mycoid-animated corpses, destroyed by Breeches' bomb.

entities.name: Belligerent
entities.description: The pirate ship Malcolm served aboard.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact sought by many during the race for Orazca.

events.summary: Vraska hires Malcolm to serve aboard the Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Malcolm was hired by Captain Vraska to serve aboard the pirate ship Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: At Orazca Malcolm's song paralyzes the combatants over the Immortal Sun, letting Breeches stop Vona from killing Huatli.
events.quote: Malcolm used his song to paralyze Huatli , Tishana , Vona , and Mavren Fein

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches investigate Downtown and escape the Mycotyrant; Breeches destroys it with a bomb.
events.quote: Breeches destroyed the Mycotyrant with a powerful bomb

events.summary: Vraska contacts the pair and they agree to help with a vault plot on Thunder Junction.
events.quote: They were overjoyed to see her alive.

events.summary: Malcolm joins Oko's outlaw team as a spotter to secretly support Vraska.
events.quote: Malcolm joined the team as a spotter

events.summary: The team secures the key; Jace claims Loot and triggers a collapse; the team escapes.
events.quote: Jace revealed himself and secured his prize, a young creature named Loot .

relations.quote: a lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition of pirates on Ixalan
Malcolm is rarely seen away from his best friend, the irrepressible goblin pirate Breeches .
Malcolm was hired by Captain Vraska
